Cure — Florence, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Cure neighbourhood itself (shops, piazza, residential streets) is a normal, calm area. The one specific, well-documented problem spot is the Sottopasso delle Cure underpass, which local political groups and press have described as suffering years of unresolved degrado — repeated fires, homeless encampments and drug use — with little improvement despite periodic clearances. This is a localised nighttime concern tied to that specific underpass rather than the wider Cure district. Sources checked: Comune di Firenze, Italia Viva statement on sottopassi degrado (Santa Maria Novella to Cure); Sinistra Progetto Comune / palagixfirenze.it, 'Sottopasso delle Cure: due anni senza cambiamenti'; FirenzeToday, repeated clearances of Sottopasso delle Cure.

Frequently asked questions

Is Cure safe?

Wandroz currently rates Cure in Florence as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Florence publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Cure safe at night?

At night, Cure is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Cure a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Cure's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Cure?

Not an official government crime feed — Cure's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
